purpose: Untimed follow-up identifying whether aggregate composition explains observed owner-route and group work; not a performance test
fixture: same three independently generated persisted SCAN fixtures, 128/192/512 nodes, after node 1 is changed and backend is reopened
queries: MATCH (n:Nodes) WHERE n.number >= 2 RETURN sum(n.number) AS total
MATCH (n:Nodes) WHERE n.number >= 2 RETURN count(n.text) AS present
MATCH (n:Nodes) WHERE n.number >= 2 RETURN sum(n.number) AS total, count(n.text) AS present
oracle: sum equals N*(N+1)/2-1+999, count equals N, exactly one result row in every case
metrics: separate scoped observer per query; same hybrid group/membership/column decodes and owner route performed/saved events; missing counters do not establish zero
interpretation: Compare structural counts, not timing; caches and plan choices can vary between queries. Multiple checks are not automatically redundant: authenticate snapshot, route and publication boundaries before proposing reuse.
